name: Financial Model Template
description: Builds a spreadsheet financial model structure with input, calculation, and output sections. Produces the formula architecture with assumption documentation and sensitivity analysis table. Outputs cell-ready formulas, not descriptions of what formulas to use. Use when the user needs to build a financial model, revenue projection, cost analysis, or business case in a spreadsheet. Do NOT use for personal budgeting (use budget-planning in personal-finance), business strategy analysis (use SWOT or financial analysis in business category), or data visualization of financial data (use chart-type-selector).
